paragraphs.en: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside the mutable surface and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions. We instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without modifying the framework core, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators. We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations. The largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points, while method rankings vary across settings and optimization gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks. RSIHub provides a common protocol for comparing evolution policies, inspectable candidate histories, and reusable components for developing new methods.

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents are commonly developed through an empirical loop: developers inspect executions, revise prompts, reusable skills, tools, or orchestration, and reevaluate the resulting behavior [ 14 , 32 ] . Agent-evolution systems automate parts of this loop by turning execution feedback into persistent changes to the agent [ 14 , 1 , 42 , 39 ] ; some also revise parts of the improvement procedure [ 5 , 41 , 40 ] . Program-optimization methods apply a similar feedback loop to language-model programs and textual components [ 11 , 37 ] . Across both settings, each iteration selects a candidate to extend, gathers evidence from its behavior, proposes and evaluates a revision, and retains the outcome for later search. This recurring lifecycle provides a common structure across these systems.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型智能体通常通过一个经验性循环来开发：开发者检查执行过程，修改提示词、可复用技能、工具或编排方式，并重新评估所得行为 [14, 32]。 智能体演化系统通过将执行反馈转化为对智能体的持久性更改，使这一循环的部分环节得以自动化 [14, 1, 42, 39]；其中一些系统还会修改改进流程的某些部分 [5, 41, 40]。 程序优化方法将类似的反馈循环应用于语言模型程序和文本化组件 [11, 37]。 在上述两种场景中，每次迭代都会选择一个候选对象进行扩展，从其行为中收集证据，提出并评估修改方案，并保留结果以供后续搜索使用。 这种反复出现的生命周期为这些系统提供了共同的结构。

paragraphs.en: Agent-evolution methods vary in how they instantiate this lifecycle and in which resources they allow to change. Much of the supporting infrastructure nevertheless recurs: isolated candidate workspaces, task execution and evaluation, artifact retention, recovery, and lineage. Implementations commonly bundle this infrastructure with method policy. As a result, implementing a method can require building another end-to-end system, while comparing methods requires reconciling runners, configurations, and evaluator interfaces. These costs motivate common infrastructure on which researchers can test new evolution ideas without rebuilding workspaces, execution, and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体演化方法在如何实例化这一生命周期以及允许改变哪些资源方面各不相同。 然而，大部分支撑性基础设施是反复出现的：隔离的候选工作区、任务执行与评估、产物保留、恢复以及谱系。 各种实现通常将这类基础设施与方法策略捆绑在一起。 因此，实现一种方法可能需要再构建一个端到端系统，而比较不同方法则需要协调不同的运行器、配置和评估器接口。 这些成本促使人们构建通用基础设施，让研究人员可以在其上测试新的演化想法，而无需重建工作区、执行和评估。

paragraphs.en: To meet this need, we introduce RSIHub, a composable framework that separates method policy from this recurring infrastructure. As Figure 1 illustrates, a recipe binds one implementation to each enabled operator interface, declares the mutable surface, and specifies the run configuration: the target, evaluator, runtime, and data splits. A framework-managed evolution loop invokes the selected operators to choose a parent, gather evidence, revise a candidate, and decide what to retain. A protected runtime executes and evaluates candidates under that configuration, and the framework writes their outcomes to the verified archive. In the agent-driven mode, an outer agent adapts the recipe between iterations under the same lifecycle and evaluation boundaries. Shared framework services provide workspace construction, artifacts, recovery, and lineage. New operator implementations plug into these stable interfaces, leaving the framework core unchanged. This follows the organization used by research frameworks in adjacent fields: stable interfaces expose research choices while shared runtime mechanics support their execution [ 22 , 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为满足这一需求，我们提出了 RSIHub，一个可组合的框架，它将方法策略与这类重复出现的基础设施分离开来。 如图 1 所示，一个配方将每个已启用的算子接口绑定到一个实现，声明可变表面，并指定运行配置：目标、评估器、运行时和数据划分。 由框架管理的演化循环调用所选算子来选择父代、收集证据、修改候选，并决定保留哪些内容。 受保护的运行时在该配置下执行并评估候选，框架将其结果写入已验证存档。 在智能体驱动模式下，一个外部智能体在相同的生命周期和评估边界内于迭代之间调整配方。 共享的框架服务提供工作区构建、工件、恢复和谱系功能。 新的算子实现可插入这些稳定接口，而框架核心保持不变。 这遵循了相邻领域中研究框架所采用的组织方式：稳定接口暴露研究选择，同时共享的运行时机制支持其执行 [ 22 , 25 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The protected-runtime layer addresses a central attribution risk in broadly mutable evolution systems. Method-controlled changes to evaluation can alter measurement conditions, while changes to record keeping can rewrite the reported evidence; either can make an apparent gain ambiguous. RSIHub addresses this risk by keeping evaluation and its archive under framework control, outside the declared mutable surface. Framework services associate each result with the committed candidate and evaluation conditions that produced it; a separate Gate operator decides whether the evaluated candidate is eligible to become a parent.
paragraphs.zh: 受保护运行时层解决了高度可变演化系统中的核心归因风险。 由方法控制的评估变更可能改变测量条件，而记录保存的变更可能重写所报告的证据；任一情况都可能使表面上的收益变得模糊不清。 RSIHub 通过将评估及其归档置于框架控制之下、置于声明的可变表面之外来应对这一风险。 框架服务将每个结果与产生该结果的已提交候选智能体及评估条件相关联；由单独的 Gate 操作员决定被评估的候选智能体是否有资格成为父代。

paragraphs.en: Agent improvement spans inference-time feedback, persistent artifact optimization, and self-modification. Reflexion retains linguistic feedback across trials; Self-Refine revises outputs at test time [ 28 , 17 ] . RAM improves external memory through communications [ 12 ] . Related work examines memory mechanisms [ 9 ] , reflection learning [ 13 ] , uncertainty-aware preference optimization [ 30 ] , and reward-model self-improvement [ 31 ] . DSPy and TextGrad optimize language-model programs or textual variables [ 11 , 37 ] . Promptbreeder evolves task and mutation prompts; ACE evolves context playbooks; and CoEvoSkills evolves multi-file skills with a separate surrogate verifier [ 5 , 42 , 39 ] . EffiSkill mines reusable skills for code-efficiency optimization [ 34 ] . GPTSwarm optimizes agent graphs, while AgentSquare searches combinations of planning, reasoning, tool-use, and memory modules [ 44 , 24 ] . EvoAgentX integrates optimizers for evolving multi-agent workflows [ 33 ] . In autoresearch, Fork-and-Flush combines workspace inheritance with fresh conversational contexts and branch selection to diversify candidate search [ 2 ] . Our recipes adapt selected policies from four approaches. A-Evolve frames deployment-time adaptation as goal-directed optimization over persistent system state [ 15 ] . AHE guides revisions to harness files with distilled execution evidence [ 14 ] ; GEPA uses trajectory reflection and Pareto selection to optimize prompts [ 1 ] ; and Hyperagents combines a task agent and a self-modifying meta agent in one editable program, allowing the improvement procedure to evolve [ 41 ] . Other approaches include STOP, which revises optimizer scaffolding; ADAS, which generates agent programs with a meta agent; DGM, which modifies its coding agent; and AlphaEvolve, which evolves target algorithms [ 38 , 8 , 40 , 20 ] . RSIHub provides shared execution, lifecycle, and evidence services for comparing our four policy adaptations.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体改进涵盖推理时反馈、持久化产物的优化以及自我修改。 Reflexion 在多次尝试间保留语言反馈；Self-Refine 在测试时修改输出 [ 28 , 17 ] 。 RAM 通过通信改进外部记忆 [ 12 ] 。 相关工作考察了记忆机制 [ 9 ] 、反思学习 [ 13 ] 、不确定性感知的偏好优化 [ 30 ] ，以及奖励模型的自我改进 [ 31 ] 。 DSPy 和 TextGrad 优化语言模型程序或文本变量 [ 11 , 37 ] 。 Promptbreeder 进化任务提示词和变异提示词；ACE 进化上下文操作手册；CoEvoSkills 则借助一个独立的替代验证器进化多文件技能 [ 5 , 42 , 39 ] 。 EffiSkill 为代码效率优化挖掘可复用技能 [ 34 ] 。 GPTSwarm 优化智能体图，而 AgentSquare 搜索规划、推理、工具使用和记忆模块的组合 [ 44 , 24 ] 。 EvoAgentX 集成了多种优化器以进化多智能体工作流 [ 33 ] 。 在自动研究领域，Fork-and-Flush 将工作区继承与全新的会话上下文及分支选择相结合，以实现候选搜索的多样化 [ 2 ] 。 我们的方法从四种方法中选取策略并加以适配。 A-Evolve 将部署时适配框定为对持久化系统状态进行目标导向的优化 [ 15 ] 。 AHE 利用提炼后的执行证据指导对测试脚手架文件的修订 [ 14 ] ；GEPA 使用轨迹反思和帕累托选择来优化提示词 [ 1 ] ；Hyperagents 则将一个任务智能体和一个自我修改的元智能体组合在同一个可编辑程序中，使改进流程本身得以进化 [ 41 ] 。 其他方法包括：修改优化器脚手架的 STOP；通过元智能体生成智能体程序的 ADAS；修改其自身编码智能体的 DGM；以及进化目标算法的 AlphaEvolve [ 38 , 8 , 40 , 20 ] 。 RSIHub 提供共享的执行、生命周期与证据服务，用于比较我们的四种策略适配方案。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks cover software engineering, terminal interaction, and knowledge-grounded dialogue [ 10 , 18 , 26 ] . paragraphs.en: The AI4AI survey distinguishes measured gains, retention, and held-out transfer [ 35 ] . Software-provenance and reproducibility systems authenticate authorized production steps, bind identities to signed artifacts, or package executions with their dependencies [ 29 , 19 , 3 ] . RSIHub records candidate lineage, distinguishes parent selection from post-evaluation Gate decisions, and binds outcomes to candidates, recipes, and evaluation conditions. Controlled skill-evolution experiments show that persistent improvement can be sparse and depend on feedback, validation, models, and benchmarks [ 16 ] . In a synthetic reward-model setting, overoptimizing an imperfect proxy can reduce performance under a fixed gold-standard reward model [ 6 ] . After curriculum training in deliberately gameable environments, behavior meeting an operational definition of reward tampering appeared in a small but non-negligible share of cases; the authors note that this definition admits false positives [ 4 ] . RSIHub services write certified evaluation fields and filter operator-supplied Record annotations before appending them. This supports attribution under the framework’s trust assumptions; benchmark overfitting and broader specification gaming remain evaluator- and study-level concerns.
paragraphs.zh: AI4AI 综述区分了测得的收益、保持能力与留出迁移 [ 35 ] 。 软件来源与可复现性系统用于认证经授权的生产步骤、将身份绑定到签名制品，或将执行过程与其依赖一起打包 [ 29 , 19 , 3 ] 。 RSIHub 记录候选的谱系，将父代选择与评估后 Gate 决策区分开来，并将结果绑定到候选、配方与评估条件上。 受控的技能演化实验表明，持续的改进可能很稀少，并且依赖于反馈、验证、模型与基准 [ 16 ] 。 在合成的奖励模型设置中，对一个不完善的代理目标进行过度优化，可能会在固定的黄金标准奖励模型下降低性能 [ 6 ] 。 在刻意可被操纵的环境中完成课程训练之后，满足奖励篡改操作性定义的行为出现在少数但不可忽视的案例中；作者指出这一定义可能产生假阳性 [ 4 ] 。 RSIHub 服务在追加写入时写入经过认证的评估字段，并过滤操作员提供的 Record 注释。 这在该框架的信任假设下支持归因；基准过拟合以及更广泛的规范博弈仍是评估器与研究层面的问题。

paragraphs.en: RSIHub separates method policy from the shared mechanics of candidate execution, evaluation, and record keeping. This section states the principles behind that separation, then describes how the candidate lifecycle and provenance model realize it.

paragraphs.en: RSIHub is built so that a researcher can assemble an evolution method from interchangeable parts, decide what those parts may change and what they may see, and reuse framework services for recurring mechanics.
paragraphs.zh: RSIHub 的设计目标是让研究者能够用可互换的组件组装出一种演化方法，决定这些组件可以改变什么、可以看到什么，并复用框架服务来处理重复出现的机制。

paragraphs.en: Assemble methods from interchangeable parts. RSIHub fixes the slots of the evolution lifecycle and leaves their contents open. A stage is a slot such as select or mutate . An operator is one implementation of a stage. A recipe names the operator it wants in each slot and configures it. When the required operator implementations are available, a recipe can express the method-specific choices through configuration.

paragraphs.en: Say what a method may change and see. Two recipe declarations make this an experimental choice. The surface block declares the resources a candidate may change, allowing the same operator interfaces to support prompt-only and whole-harness studies. The mutate block configures how the editing agent runs and which retained context it receives. Together, these declarations distinguish the persistent resources being evolved from the information used to propose each revision.

paragraphs.en: Provide the rest of the pipeline once. Workspace construction, candidate snapshots, evaluation execution, artifact retention, terminal-state classification, recovery from interrupted runs, and lineage bookkeeping commonly recur across evolution methods. RSIHub implements these services once and gives every recipe the same execution path. When a study changes one operator without changing the other recipe fields, it isolates one declared policy component while reusing the same framework mechanics.

paragraphs.en: RSIHub implements this lifecycle on Harbor [ 7 ] , which provides container execution, trajectory capture, and per-task verification. Above this substrate, RSIHub manages candidate lineage, train/gate/sealed splits, mutable-surface enforcement, and certified evaluation records.

paragraphs.en: The lifecycle accepts either a fixed, researcher-authored recipe or one supplied by an outer agent. In the agent-driven mode, the outer agent uses a recipe-authoring skill to compose the initial recipe and may revise its operator bindings and policy settings using permitted feedback after each completed iteration. The outer agent adapts the evolution procedure, while Mutate edits the candidate within an iteration. The target, evaluator, runtime, data splits, and allowed mutable surface remain fixed; sealed tasks are excluded from adaptation feedback. Our experiments evaluate fixed recipes.
paragraphs.zh: 该生命周期接受固定的、由研究者编写的配方，或由外部智能体提供的配方。 在智能体驱动模式下，外部智能体使用配方编写技能来构建初始配方，并可在每次迭代完成后根据允许的反馈修订其算子绑定和策略设置。 外部智能体调整演化流程，而 Mutate 在迭代内编辑候选对象。 目标、评估器、运行时、数据划分以及允许修改的范围保持固定；封闭任务不参与适应反馈。 我们的实验评估的是固定配方。

paragraphs.en: Before each iteration, the framework validates and snapshots the active recipe, resolving every binding and checking its settings against the operator’s schema. Each operator runs in a separate process, and the framework validates its structured output before using it.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次迭代之前，框架会对当前活跃的配方进行验证并生成快照，解析每个绑定，并根据操作符的 schema 检查其设置。 每个操作符在单独的进程中运行，框架在使用其结构化输出之前会先进行验证。

paragraphs.en: The archive separates framework-certified fields, the evaluated candidate, its parent, the evaluation conditions, and the outcome, from method-specific annotations. Operators propose annotations; the framework filters and writes them.
paragraphs.zh: 归档将框架认证字段、被评估的候选智能体、其父智能体、评估条件和结果，与方法特定的标注分离开来。 由操作者提出标注；由框架进行过滤并写入。

paragraphs.en: Select. Chooses an eligible parent from the archive according to the recipe’s search policy. The framework verifies its identity and forks its exact recorded commit.
paragraphs.zh: 选择。 根据配方（recipe）的搜索策略，从存档中选择一个符合条件的父代。 该框架会验证其身份，并派生其确切记录的提交（commit）。

paragraphs.en: Rollout. Runs the parent on training tasks and returns execution evidence as a summary and retained artifact references. The supplied Harbor rollout uses only the training split; a replay-based rollout reuses the parent’s recorded evaluation instead of running again.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹生成（Rollout）。 在训练任务上运行父智能体，并以摘要和保留的工件引用形式返回执行证据。 提供的 Harbor 轨迹生成仅使用训练集划分；基于重放的轨迹生成会复用父智能体已记录的评估结果，而不是重新运行。

paragraphs.en: Mutate. Proposes edits within the declared mutable surface. The operator is typically an agent rather than a fixed transformation: it works over multiple turns, may run small-scale trials on training tasks before proposing a change, and, as in Hyperagents, may edit the evolution operators themselves when the surface allows. It reports changed paths, notes, and usage.
paragraphs.zh: 变异。 在声明的可变范围内提出修改。 该操作符通常是一个智能体，而非固定的转换：它在多个回合中工作，可能在提出更改之前先在训练任务上进行小规模试验，并且正如 Hyperagents 中那样，当范围允许时可能会编辑演化操作符本身。 它会报告更改的路径、说明和用法。

paragraphs.en: When a recipe places operators inside the mutable surface, the framework must decide which version of an operator runs. This candidate-level mechanism is distinct from an outer agent revising recipe bindings or settings between iterations. For each stage invocation, it loads the implementation from the checkout supplied to that stage. Changes to already-run stages take effect in a later generation, while changes to Validate or Novelty may affect the current proposal. Gate and Record subsequently load from the committed child. The certified record provides a recovery checkpoint after evaluation: it holds the committed child and its outcome before downstream finalization. Gate, Record, and Reflect may add policy outputs but cannot alter certified evaluation fields.
paragraphs.zh: 当配方将算子置于可变表层内时，框架必须决定运行哪个版本的算子。 这种候选级机制不同于外层智能体在各次迭代之间修改配方绑定或设置。 对于每次阶段调用，它从提供给该阶段的检出中加载实现。 对已运行阶段的更改在后续代次中生效，而对 Validate 或 Novelty 的更改可能影响当前提案。 Gate 和 Record 随后从已提交的子项中加载。 认证记录在评估之后提供了一个恢复检查点：它在下游最终定稿之前保存已提交的子项及其结果。 Gate、Record 和 Reflect 可以添加策略输出，但不能更改已认证的评估字段。

paragraphs.en: A certified evaluation event ties the committed candidate, its parent, and the active recipe snapshot to evaluator and task-set fingerprints, trials, score, costs, artifact references, and lineage. A hash-referenced contract can also record evaluator-configuration and dataset-content digests, split and repetition settings, model identity, retry policy, evaluator-runtime digest, and framework version. This identity lets a study distinguish a change in method policy from a change in recorded evaluation conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 经认证的评估事件将已提交的候选、其父级以及活动配方快照与评估器指纹、任务集指纹、试验、得分、成本、工件引用和谱系绑定在一起。 哈希引用的契约还可以记录评估器配置摘要、数据集内容摘要、切分与重复设置、模型身份、重试策略、评估器运行时摘要以及框架版本。 这种身份使研究能够区分方法策略的变化与所记录评估条件的变化。

sents.zh: 经认证的评估事件将已提交的候选、其父级以及活动配方快照与评估器指纹、任务集指纹、试验、得分、成本、工件引用和谱系绑定在一起。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we organize the evaluation around three research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们围绕三个研究问题来组织评估：

paragraphs.en: RQ1: Can RSIHub support effective agent evolution?
paragraphs.zh: RQ1: RSIHub 能否支持有效的智能体演化？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: Does RSIHub preserve the capabilities of the agents it executes?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2: RSIHub 是否能保留其执行的智能体的能力？

paragraphs.en: RQ3: Does RSIHub preserve the integrity of agent-evolution experiments?
paragraphs.zh: RQ3: RSIHub 是否能保持智能体演化实验的完整性？

paragraphs.en: To answer these questions, we compare evolution recipes across agents, benchmarks, and held-out splits for RQ1, use generation-zero controls against direct execution for RQ2, and conduct fault-injection and boundary-enforcement trials for RQ3.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这些问题，我们在 RQ1 中比较了跨智能体、基准测试和留出集（held-out splits）的演化配方，在 RQ2 中使用第零代对照与直接执行进行对比，并在 RQ3 中进行了故障注入与边界强制试验。

Terminal Bench 2 contains 89 tasks split into 50 train, 19 gate, and 20 sealed tasks; τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking contains 97 tasks split into 50 train, 20 gate, and 27 sealed tasks. Train trajectories provide evolution feedback, gate tasks support candidate admission, and sealed tasks are excluded from mutation feedback and used only for held-out reporting. Because the splits have different sizes, each split column in Table 1 is its contribution to the full-benchmark score, e.g., N pass , s / N all N_{\mathrm{pass},s}/N_{\mathrm{all}} .

paragraphs.en: Protocol. We test the effectiveness conjecture by comparing each evolved recipe with its seed under shared conditions. Overall score changes probe whether the framework can support effective improvement; train, gate, and sealed results reveal whether those improvements survive admission and extend beyond the trajectories used to propose revisions. Crossing agents, benchmarks, and methods makes the conjecture answerable across heterogeneous settings rather than a single favorable configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 我们通过在相同条件下将每个演化出的配方与其种子进行比较，来检验有效性猜想。 总分变化用于探究该框架能否支持有效的改进；训练、门控和封存结果则揭示这些改进能否通过准入并在超出用于提出修订的轨迹之外仍然成立。 将智能体、基准和方法进行交叉组合，使这一猜想可以在异构环境中得到检验，而不是仅在某个有利的单一配置下得到验证。

paragraphs.en: Overall performance. The results show substantial gains, with their size depending on the benchmark, seed agent, and evolution method. On Terminal Bench 2, every method improves the MiniSWE baseline by 7.8–13.5 percentage points; Hyperagents and A-Evolve reach the highest overall score of 69.7. Gains are smaller from the stronger Codex baseline: AHE reaches 71.9 ( + 2.2 +2.2 points), Hyperagents and A-Evolve each add 1.1 points, and GEPA preserves the baseline. The pattern changes on τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking. Hyperagents gives the largest MiniSWE improvement, from 27.8 to 33.0, whereas AHE performs best with Codex, raising the overall score from 24.7 to 34.0. GEPA is close behind at 33.0. These shifts indicate that method rankings are conditional on both the task environment and the starting agent.
paragraphs.zh: 总体性能。 结果显示出显著的提升，提升幅度取决于基准测试、种子智能体和演化方法。 在 Terminal Bench 2 上，所有方法都将 MiniSWE 基线提升了 7.8–13.5 个百分点；Hyperagents 和 A-Evolve 达到了 69.7 的最高总分。 从更强的 Codex 基线出发提升幅度较小：AHE 达到 71.9（+2.2 分），Hyperagents 和 A-Evolve 各增加 1.1 分，GEPA 则与基线持平。 在 τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking 上，模式发生了变化。 Hyperagents 对 MiniSWE 的提升最大，从 27.8 提升到 33.0，而 AHE 在 Codex 上表现最佳，将总分从 24.7 提升到 34.0。 GEPA 以 33.0 紧随其后。 这些变化表明，方法排名取决于任务环境和起始智能体两者。

paragraphs.en: Task split-level behavior. The split scores expose tradeoffs hidden by the overall metric. With MiniSWE on Terminal Bench 2, all methods improve the train and sealed splits, while only Hyperagents improves the gate split. A-Evolve obtains the largest train gain ( + 7.9 +7.9 points) and ties Hyperagents on sealed performance, yet its gate score is unchanged. With Codex, AHE and Hyperagents improve train and sealed performance while decreasing gate performance by 3.4 and 2.2 points, respectively. On τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking, Hyperagents produces the largest overall gain from MiniSWE despite a 2.1-point sealed regression; AHE and GEPA also lose 4.1 and 2.1 points on sealed tasks. The Codex results are more consistent across held-out splits: AHE improves train, gate, and sealed scores by 1.0, 3.0, and 5.1 points, while GEPA preserves train performance and improves both gate and sealed scores by 4.1 points.
paragraphs.zh: 任务拆分层级的行为表现。 拆分后的分数揭示了总体指标所掩盖的权衡关系。 在 Terminal Bench 2 上使用 MiniSWE 时，所有方法都能提升训练集与封存集的分数，但只有 Hyperagents 能提升门控集的分数。 A-Evolve 获得了最大的训练集增益（+7.9 分），并在封存集表现上与 Hyperagents 持平，但其门控集分数没有变化。 使用 Codex 时，AHE 和 Hyperagents 提升了训练集与封存集的表现，但门控集表现分别下降了 3.4 分和 2.2 分。 在 τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking 上，Hyperagents 尽管 封存集出现 2.1 分的退步，却带来了 MiniSWE 最大的整体增益；AHE 和 GEPA 在封存任务上也分别损失了 4.1 分和 2.1 分。 Codex 的结果在各保留集上更为一致：AHE 将训练集、门控集和封存集分数分别提升了 1.0 分、3.0 分和 5.1 分，而 GEPA 保持了训练集表现，并将门控集和封存集分数均提升了 4.1 分。

sents.zh: 任务拆分层级的行为表现。

sents.en: The split scores expose tradeoffs hidden by the overall metric.
sents.zh: 拆分后的分数揭示了总体指标所掩盖的权衡关系。

sents.en: With MiniSWE on Terminal Bench 2, all methods improve the train and sealed splits, while only Hyperagents improves the gate split.
sents.zh: 在 Terminal Bench 2 上使用 MiniSWE 时，所有方法都能提升训练集与封存集的分数，但只有 Hyperagents 能提升门控集的分数。

sents.en: A-Evolve obtains the largest train gain ( + 7.9 +7.9 points) and ties Hyperagents on sealed performance, yet its gate score is unchanged.
sents.zh: A-Evolve 获得了最大的训练集增益（+7.9 分），并在封存集表现上与 Hyperagents 持平，但其门控集分数没有变化。

sents.en: With Codex, AHE and Hyperagents improve train and sealed performance while decreasing gate performance by 3.4 and 2.2 points, respectively.
sents.zh: 使用 Codex 时，AHE 和 Hyperagents 提升了训练集与封存集的表现，但门控集表现分别下降了 3.4 分和 2.2 分。

sents.en: On τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking, Hyperagents produces the largest overall gain from MiniSWE despite a 2.1-point sealed regression; AHE and GEPA also lose 4.1 and 2.1 points on sealed tasks.
sents.zh: 在 τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking 上，Hyperagents 尽管 封存集出现 2.1 分的退步，却带来了 MiniSWE 最大的整体增益；AHE 和 GEPA 在封存任务上也分别损失了 4.1 分和 2.1 分。

sents.en: The Codex results are more consistent across held-out splits: AHE improves train, gate, and sealed scores by 1.0, 3.0, and 5.1 points, while GEPA preserves train performance and improves both gate and sealed scores by 4.1 points.
sents.zh: Codex 的结果在各保留集上更为一致：AHE 将训练集、门控集和封存集分数分别提升了 1.0 分、3.0 分和 5.1 分，而 GEPA 保持了训练集表现，并将门控集和封存集分数均提升了 4.1 分。

paragraphs.en: Implications. No method dominates across benchmarks, seeds, and splits. These setting-dependent outcomes motivate RSIHub’s support for changing evolution policies while retaining a common execution and evaluation pipeline. Gate regressions on Terminal Bench 2 and sealed regressions on τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking show why inspectable evidence matters: a higher overall score can conceal held-out losses. Split-level results tied to candidate records help researchers diagnose unsuccessful adaptations and choose which policies to investigate further. Substantial gains occur in several configurations, including on sealed tasks, but neither improvement nor transfer is uniform. These descriptive point estimates do not establish the stability of close differences without repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 启示。 没有任何方法能在所有基准、种子和数据划分上全面占优。 这些依赖于具体设置的结果促使 RSIHub 支持在保留统一执行与评估流程的同时更换进化策略。 在 Terminal Bench 2 上的门控回归以及在 τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking 上的密封回归表明为什么可查验的证据至关重要：更高的总分可能掩盖了留出集上的损失。 与候选记录相关联的划分级别结果有助于研究人员诊断失败的适配，并选择值得进一步研究的策略。 在包括密封任务在内的若干配置中出现了可观的增益，但改进和迁移都不具有一致性。 在没有多次重复运行的情况下，这些描述性的点估计无法确立相近差异的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. To test the fidelity conjecture without confounding it with evolution, we compare framework-mediated execution of an unchanged seed agent with Direct execution. Direct execution denotes invoking the frozen evaluator outside RSIHub without creating or recording framework state. Direct-A and Direct-B are two independent direct executions placed before and after the RSIHub execution, respectively. For each condition, we conduct three repetitions, each running the same unchanged seed agent in the fixed order Direct-A, RSIHub generation zero, and Direct-B under identical model, task, evaluator, and runtime settings. We report Avg@3 as the mean pass@1 across the three repetitions. Within each repetition, the Direct score is the mean of Direct-A and Direct-B. D–D agreement measures agreement between Direct-A and Direct-B. D–R agreement is the mean of the Direct-A–RSIHub and Direct-B–RSIHub task-level agreements, and excess disagreement is the mean cross-mode disagreement rate minus the D–D disagreement rate.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 为了在不与进化混淆的情况下检验保真度猜想，我们将经由框架介导执行的未修改种子智能体与直接执行进行比较。 直接执行指在 RSIHub 之外调用冻结的评估器，而不创建或记录框架状态。 Direct-A 和 Direct-B 分别是置于 RSIHub 执行之前和之后的两次独立直接执行。 对于每个条件，我们进行三次重复，每次在相同的模型、任务、评估器和运行时设置下，按 Direct-A、RSIHub 零代、Direct-B 的固定顺序运行同一个未修改的种子智能体。 我们报告 Avg@3，即三次重复的 pass@1 均值。 在每次重复内，Direct 得分是 Direct-A 和 Direct-B 的均值。 D–D 一致性衡量 Direct-A 与 Direct-B 之间的一致性。 D–R 一致性是 Direct-A–RSIHub 与 Direct-B–RSIHub 任务级一致性的均值，而超额不一致率是平均跨模式不一致率减去 D–D 不一致率。

sents.en: Protocol.
sents.zh: 协议。

paragraphs.en: Results. On Terminal Bench 2, both agents change by − 2.6 -2.6 points. MiniSWE’s D–R agreement is 84.6%, compared with 83.5% D–D agreement. Codex has 82.0% D–R agreement versus 88.0% D–D agreement, yielding + 6.0 +6.0 points of excess disagreement; its RSIHub Avg@3 of 61.4 lies within the 60.7–65.2 range across the six direct executions. On τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking, MiniSWE and Codex change by − 2.6 -2.6 and + 3.4 +3.4 points, with excess disagreement of + 0.2 +0.2 and + 2.1 +2.1 points. Direct executions themselves disagree on 12.0–18.9% of tasks. These controls characterize execution variability; they do not establish execution-mode equivalence or the statistical significance of the single-run evolution gains. See Section B.1 for details.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。在 Terminal Bench 2 上，两个智能体变化为 − 2.6 -2.6 分。MiniSWE 的 D–R 一致率为 84.6%，而 D–D 一致率为 83.5%。Codex 的 D–R 一致率为 82.0%，D–D 一致率为 88.0%，产生 + 6.0 +6.0 分的过度分歧；其 RSIHub Avg@3 为 61.4，位于六次直接执行的 60.7–65.2 范围之内。在 τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking 上，MiniSWE 和 Codex 分别变化 − 2.6 -2.6 分和 + 3.4 +3.4 分，过度分歧分别为 + 0.2 +0.2 分和 + 2.1 +2.1 分。直接执行本身在 12.0–18.9% 的任务上存在分歧。这些对照刻画了执行变异性；它们并未确立执行模式的等价性，也未确立单次运行演化增益的统计显著性。详见 B.1 节。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. We test the integrity conjecture by terminating runs during mutation or evaluation and after writing an evaluation receipt, then resuming and comparing the recovered state with an uninterrupted control. We also attempt evaluator mutation, writes outside the declared mutable surface, access to gate, sealed, and anchor evidence, and forged archive outcomes. We run 30 independent trials per scenario in each benchmark campaign. A trial passes only if the workspace reaches a valid and attributable state, unauthorized changes cannot affect an accepted result, and the champion remains reproducible from framework evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 我们通过在变异或求值过程中以及写入求值回执之后终止运行，再恢复运行并将恢复后的状态与不间断的对照进行比较，来检验完整性猜想。 我们还尝试求值器变异、在声明的可变表面之外写入、访问门控、密封和锚定证据，以及伪造的归档结果。 在每次基准测试活动中，我们针对每个场景运行 30 次独立试验。 只有当工作区达到有效且可归因的状态、未经授权的更改无法影响已接受的结果、并且冠军仍可从框架证据中复现时，试验才算通过。

sents.zh: 协议。

These results support integrity only within the tested lifecycle boundaries and attack cases. Method authors can reuse these tested recovery and evidence checks across recipes. Appendix B reports runtime overhead and method-integration effort.

paragraphs.en: RSIHub provides open, reusable infrastructure for agent evolution. All four evaluated adaptations reuse framework services without framework source changes. Gains and held-out transfer vary across settings, motivating shared protocols and inspectable evidence for policy comparison. We invite researchers to build on the released recipes, compare new policy components, and contribute operators that others can reuse.
paragraphs.zh: RSIHub 为智能体演化提供开放、可复用的基础设施。 所评估的四种适配均在未更改框架源代码的情况下复用了框架服务。 收益与保留集迁移在不同设置下有所差异，这促使我们为策略比较建立共享协议与可审查的证据。 我们邀请研究者基于已发布的方案进行构建，比较新的策略组件，并贡献可供他人复用的算子。

paragraphs.en: The agent-driven path extends this separation to adaptive recipe revision: an outer agent may revise operator bindings and settings between iterations, while the evaluator, sealed split, and certified record remain protected. Together, these interfaces provide a shared foundation for studying agent self-improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 由智能体驱动的路径将这种分离扩展到自适应配方修订：外层智能体可以在迭代之间修订算子绑定与设置，而评估器、密封的划分以及经过认证的记录仍受到保护。 这些接口共同为研究智能体自我改进提供了一个共同的基础。

paragraphs.en: RSIHub’s evidence guarantees rely on trusted framework services, host and filesystem protections, Git and digest operations, configured external services, and valid evaluators. Our results apply to the workloads, hosts, and lifecycle boundaries tested in this study, and the capability-preservation measurements assess task-level agreement rather than full behavioral equivalence. Runtime fingerprints do not replace host or service attestation, and RSIHub does not contain hostile code, so stronger deployments require independent attestation, isolation, and containment.
paragraphs.zh: RSIHub 的证据保障依赖于可信的框架服务、主机与文件系统保护、Git 与摘要操作、已配置的外部服务以及有效的评估器。 我们的结果适用于本研究中测试的工作负载、主机和生命周期边界，且能力保持度量评估的是任务级一致性而非完整的行为等价性。 运行时指纹不能替代主机或服务的远程证明，且 RSIHub 本身不包含恶意代码，因此更强的部署需要独立的远程证明、隔离与遏制。

paragraphs.en: The reported results characterize fixed, recipe-driven runs rather than adaptive recipe revision by an outer agent.

paragraphs.en: RSIHub can enable unsafe capability growth, reward gaming, or exposure of sensitive traces. Higher pass@1 does not establish safe deployment or exclude harmful intermediate actions; banking-benchmark success does not establish suitability for financial decisions. RSIHub supports auditing and rollback, not containment: editable operators and candidate adapters may execute on the host, beyond task-container isolation and feedback filtering.
paragraphs.zh: RSIHub 可能导致不安全的能力增长、奖励博弈，或敏感轨迹的暴露。 更高的 pass@1 并不能确立安全部署，也不能排除有害的中间动作；银行基准测试的成功并不能确立其在金融决策中的适用性。 RSIHub 支持审计与回滚，而非遏制：可编辑的算子和候选适配器可能在宿主机上执行，超出任务容器隔离和反馈过滤的范围。

paragraphs.en: Deployers should restrict filesystem and network access, exclude production credentials, and require held-out safety evaluation and human review before promotion. Resource budgets and halt and rollback controls are needed, although rollback cannot undo external actions or disclosures. Trajectories and archives need access controls, retention limits, and redaction before sharing.

paragraphs.en: Protocol. We measured the cost of the services shared across recipes on both benchmark workloads by instrumenting workspace initialization, candidate snapshotting, mutable-surface validation, evaluation recording, integrity verification, and recovery separately from model inference, benchmark execution, and mutation. For Terminal Bench 2, initialization uses 50 microbenchmark repetitions, recovery uses 30 replay trials, and the four regular-operation rows and end-to-end shares use 20 complete Gen-1 runs, five per method. Each regular-operation sample sums the relevant exclusive spans within one generation, and we compute the median and P95 over the 20 per-generation totals. The reported generation share uses the union of the framework’s exclusive spans rather than summing nested durations. Because the campaigns ran on different hosts, we report their latency distributions separately.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 我们通过对工作区初始化、候选快照、可变表面验证、评估记录、完整性验证和恢复分别进行插桩测量，而非模型推理、基准执行和变异，从而测量两种基准工作负载中各配方共享服务的开销。 对于 Terminal Bench 2，初始化使用 50 次微基准重复，恢复使用 30 次重放试验，四行常规操作和端到端份额使用 20 次 Gen-1 完整运行，每种方法五次。 每个常规操作样本汇总单代内相关的独占时间跨度，并计算 20 个单代总和的中位数和 P95。 报告的代份额使用框架独占时间跨度的并集，而非对嵌套时长求和。 由于各实验在不同的主机上运行，我们分别报告它们的延迟分布。

sents.en: Protocol.
sents.zh: 协议。

paragraphs.en: Results. Workspace initialization was the largest measured operation in the τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking campaign, with a median of 1.23 seconds, whereas candidate snapshot creation and state verification were the largest regular operations on Terminal Bench 2, with medians of 0.76 and 0.65 seconds. These absolute latencies should not be compared directly across the two hosts. More importantly, framework work remained small relative to complete generations: 0.019% on τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking and a median of 0.02% on Terminal Bench 2. Model, mutation, and benchmark execution therefore dominate runtime in both measured workloads.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 在 τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking 战役中，工作区初始化是耗时最大的测量操作，中位数为 1.23 秒；而在 Terminal Bench 2 上，候选快照创建和状态验证是耗时最大的常规操作，中位数分别为 0.76 秒和 0.65 秒。 这些绝对延迟不应在两台主机之间直接比较。 更重要的是，相对于完整生成过程，框架工作占比仍然很小：在 τ 3 \tau^{3} Banking 上为 0.019%，在 Terminal Bench 2 上中位数为 0.02%。 因此，在两个测量工作负载中，模型、变异和基准测试执行是运行时间的主要来源。

paragraphs.en: Protocol. We evaluated whether the common interfaces reduce method-specific engineering by counting normalized recipe lines, new operator lines, reused operators, changes to framework source files, and integration tests for each adapted method. Reporting these quantities separately distinguishes declarative composition and reused services from genuinely new method logic.
paragraphs.zh: 协议。 我们通过对每个适配方法统计归一化后的配方行数、新增算子行数、复用算子数、框架源文件的改动以及集成测试，来评估这些通用接口是否减少了方法特定的工程工作量。 分别报告这些数量，可以将声明式组合与复用服务同真正新增的方法逻辑区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Results. At the locked experiment commit, the four adaptations required 47–61 lines of recipe configuration and reused two operator bindings each. None required a change to a framework source file, while method-specific operator implementations ranged from 216 lines for Hyperagents to 1,087 lines for AHE. Each adaptation passed its 14–47 method-specific integration tests. The separation between zero framework changes and nonzero method-specific code supports the intended extension model: research logic remains in recipes and operators while candidate execution, evaluation, recovery, and evidence services are reused.
paragraphs.zh: 结果。 在锁定的实验提交版本中，四个适配各需要 47–61 行配方配置，并各自复用了两个操作符绑定。 没有任何适配需要修改框架源文件，而方法特定的操作符实现代码量从 Hyperagents 的 216 行到 AHE 的 1,087 行不等。 每个适配都通过了其 14–47 项方法特定的集成测试。 框架零改动与方法特定代码非零之间的分离支持了预期的扩展模型：研究逻辑保留在配方和操作符中，而候选执行、评估、恢复与证据服务均被复用。

paragraphs.en: The archive is a recovery boundary: a complete certified candidate evaluation is appended before Gate and remains pending until Gate records its decision. A pending child is therefore unavailable to Select. Record annotations run after Gate and are filtered separately; Record completion is outside the parent-eligibility predicate. Table 9 summarizes the implemented restart behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 归档是一个恢复边界：一个完整的已认证候选评估会在门控（Gate）之前追加，并保持待定状态，直到门控记录其决定。 因此，待定的子项对选择（Select）不可用。 记录（Record）注解在门控之后运行并单独过滤；记录的完成不在父项资格判定谓词的范围之内。 表 9 总结了已实现的重启行为。
